name: Catholic
overview: The term 'Catholic' in Scripture relates primarily to the universal body of believers and the community surrounding Jesus, including his family and disciples. Jesus emphasizes the importance of hearing and keeping God's word as the true blessing, rather than mere physical kinship (Mark 3:31; Luke 11:28). He identifies himself as the exclusive way to the Father, underscoring the centrality of faith in Him for salvation (John 14:6). The passages also highlight the intimate care within the early community, as seen in Jesus entrusting His mother to the beloved disciple (John 19:27) and His peace given to the assembled believers (John 20:19). Together, these verses point to a Christ-centered faith that transcends earthly ties and is grounded in the gospel message.
